Current checkout audit · 2026-07-01 · Canonical feature and user-story ledger

No new app-code defect was confirmed. One audit-artifact logistics defect was fixed: the previously exported Summary title and subtitle were blank after re-import even though the pre-export inspection contained them.

External limitations: credentialed live OpenRouter, Z.AI, and Turso calls were not sent; a complete human VoiceOver traversal remains manual. Deterministic routing, parsing, persistence, accessibility-tree, and reduced-motion paths passed.
Primary evidence: script/lint.sh; full macOS XCTest (133 passed, 2 credential skips); full iOS UI suite (29 passed); build_and_run.sh --verify; exported-workbook formula, value, and visual QA.

Active product scope: Apple/. Legacy web and server material is reference-only. The native app has no service worker; offline behavior is local persistence and user-visible remote-provider failure handling.
